scope_rule: every decision whose classification is quality_sensitive in shared/contracts/reconstruction-decisions/*.json

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The frozen WS2tn50 shared-Qinit artifact and its training FES/hash are accepted existing evidence.

rejected_choices.text: train a different table per formal case
rejected_choices.reason: Per-formal-case training would change the learned artifact and method identity by case, preventing one fixed method identity across the formal case set.

rejected_choices.text: use sparse single-direction WS1tn10 after observing all-zero rewards
rejected_choices.reason: The sparse WS1tn10 choice is explicitly post-hoc and the superseded 680-FES probe did not reach generation 200 or exercise the full stage ambiguity.

rejected_choices.text: invent an unidentified author environment
rejected_choices.reason: No author environment exists in the evidence corpus; inventing one would be untraceable rather than an executable scientific level.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The five fixed seeds, artifact hash, and byte-identical worker replay are frozen.

rejected_choices.text: wall-clock seeds
rejected_choices.reason: Wall-clock seeds are not predetermined and cannot yield reproducible artifact identity.

rejected_choices.text: omit seed provenance from the frozen artifact
rejected_choices.reason: Omitting seed provenance makes the frozen artifact scientifically unauditable.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: Stage 4 continuation is frozen before results and the accepted test checks its work ledger.

rejected_choices.text: wrap back to stage 1 after generation 200
rejected_choices.reason: The otherwise executable stage-wrap rule was registered before the final run and evaluated as a separate method semantic on the same WS2tn50 problem.

rejected_choices.text: stop before the requested formal physical-FES budget is exhausted
rejected_choices.reason: Stopping before the requested 24000 physical FES would violate the common work denominator.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: Both compact and paper-corrected profiles were frozen before the Step 11 seed set.

rejected_choices.text: random untrained network labelled author policy
rejected_choices.reason: A random untrained network is not the declared trained-policy method identity and cannot be relabelled as author policy.

rejected_choices.text: unseeded Torch dependency
rejected_choices.reason: An unseeded Torch dependency is not reproducible and provides no frozen policy identity.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: Compact profile exposes 32 training and 448 inference FES under the fixed 480-FES receipt.

rejected_choices.text: hide training evaluations
rejected_choices.reason: Hidden training evaluations violate the shared complete-layout FES ledger.

rejected_choices.text: exclude training from the fixed budget
rejected_choices.reason: Excluding training work changes the denominator and is not an admissible fixed-budget comparison.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: Three predetermined seeds record exact learned-state and scientific-output hashes for the immediate-reward profile.

rejected_choices.text: store the running cumulative reward as each transition reward
rejected_choices.reason: Running cumulative reward changes every transition target and contradicts the declared immediate transition reward.

rejected_choices.text: hide reward evaluations outside the work ledger
rejected_choices.reason: Hidden reward evaluations violate exact physical-FES accounting.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The fixed 480-FES runs expose 430 training FES, 50 inference FES, one terminal update, and learned-state hashes.

rejected_choices.text: reuse the compact proxy value of eight interactions
rejected_choices.reason: The compact eight-interaction completion already exists and was rerun as its own fixed method semantic on the identical RPSO source problem.

rejected_choices.text: exclude PPO environment calls from FES
rejected_choices.reason: Excluding PPO environment calls from FES would hide physical evaluations.

rejected_choices.text: allow the first outer call to exceed the fixed budget silently
rejected_choices.reason: Silent budget overshoot violates exact bounded stopping.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The fixed P3 oracle and PPGA v2 receipt preserve one frozen wake completion.

rejected_choices.text: claim Eq. 10 uniquely determines all missing wake inputs
rejected_choices.reason: Equation 10 does not uniquely identify all missing original wake inputs, so claiming uniqueness would be false evidence.

rejected_choices.text: multiply successive wakes
rejected_choices.reason: Multiplicative wake combination was predeclared and run under a distinct problem semantic and hash; it is not pooled or ranked against the baseline problem.

rejected_choices.text: import Guishan terrain or wind data
rejected_choices.reason: Guishan terrain or wind data belongs to a different site and would create an unsupported mixed problem identity.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The shallow scalar eight-head completion was frozen before optimization and has exact worker replay.

rejected_choices.text: invent a multi-layer feed-forward network
rejected_choices.reason: A multi-layer feed-forward network is not specified and adds more than the isolated hidden-width uncertainty.

rejected_choices.text: select a wider hidden state after observing optimization results
rejected_choices.reason: Width two was registered before quality observation and executed as an independent method semantic, removing the rejected post-hoc selection behavior.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The P3 oracle freezes RSS wake-only deficits and target-point terrain shear.

rejected_choices.text: multiply terrain shear again after deriving a pair velocity that already contains shear
rejected_choices.reason: Applying terrain shear twice double-counts the same physical adjustment.

rejected_choices.text: multiply successive wake factors
rejected_choices.reason: Multiplicative successive wake factors were predeclared and run under a distinct problem semantic and hash with no cross-semantic pooling or ranking.

rejected_choices.text: sum signed pair velocities
rejected_choices.reason: Summing signed pair velocities is dimensionally inconsistent with the declared deficit completion.

obligations.selected_baseline_reason: The bounded deterministic kernel receipt freezes gradients, training work, and zero training physical FES.

rejected_choices.text: use finite differences for training
rejected_choices.reason: Finite differences would replace the declared analytic training method and add unledgered objective probes.

rejected_choices.text: count token or optimizer work as physical FES
rejected_choices.reason: Token and optimizer work are recorded separately but are not complete-layout physical FES.

rejected_choices.text: freeze random attention and describe it as trained
rejected_choices.reason: Frozen random attention is not trained attention and cannot be described as such.
